These are the terms for organizations distributing the five questions in [The Survey to End War and Disease](survey-to-end-war-and-disease.qmd). The paper has the questions, the predictions, the projected benefits, and the calculations.

## The ask

Your organization gets a unique link. Share the five questions with your members through it. You do not endorse any particular answer. You give your members the opportunity to participate.

## What your organization receives

- Your logo and recognition on the public results page.
- An anonymized report of responses submitted through your organization's link.
- Shareable results for your members and your own research or advocacy.
- We are seeking grant funding to compensate participating organizations for outreach. If funding is secured, compensation will follow a published formula. The formula will be based on verified, unique completed responses. Compensation will never depend on how anyone answers.

## If a question is a barrier

We prefer to keep the five questions identical so the results can be combined credibly. If one question prevents your organization from participating, please tell us which question and why. We will try to resolve the concern. If necessary, we can provide a version without that question. We will report those responses separately.
